title: 第13章 无事发生第14章 买蛇奇葩的癖好
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
安置好尸体，众人回到矿场，王虎和刘刚立刻去禀报了堂主李大龙。
进入帐篷内，两人只看到地面上一具稍显白嫩的尸体，菊花血流如注，显然，这又是李大龙的一道杰作。
之前的李二是，张三也是。
两人知道李大龙的性情，毫不在意，急忙禀报。
“先有里应外合攻击我矿场，现又暗杀我精锐帮众，黑狼帮欺我太甚。”
“如今我毒龙堂处境危险，刘刚，我命你带些人前往县城，请求总帮支援。”李大龙起身，脸色难看的说道。
黑狼帮，做的太过了。
两帮小摩擦是很多，可死的都是普通帮众，还没闹到这样特意针对精锐帮众的局面。
显然，黑狼帮有大图谋。
“是！”刘刚脸色难看的接令，在王虎冷笑的眼神下，退出了帐篷。
“呼……这下不好了，矿场距离县城足足二十里路，沿途还不知道有多危险。”
刘刚深知李大龙这是把他当问路石。
说是去县城求援，实际上就是去试探黑狼帮，换一个说法就是去死，可他又没有办法。
“不行，我得多找几个人。”
无可奈何，刘刚去了矿奴的烂篷子里，吵醒了众多的矿奴。
“各位，现在我要回县城一趟，需要一些颇有胆气的人，你们可有人追随我，只要平安回去，再回矿场，你们今后就是我毒蛇帮的帮众了。”
众多矿奴面面相觑，立刻有不少人站了出来。
有机会往上爬，人人都会报名。
刘刚脸色一喜，快速挑选起人手。
直接找了二十名比较高大的矿奴，其他矿奴一脸失落。

“赵寒，赵大……你们几个跟我走一趟县城，回总帮求援。”
赵寒正回到床上刚躺下合眼，就被刘刚吵醒了。
无可奈何，几人只得跟随。
除此之外，刘刚还挑选了三名精锐帮众，一共三十号人，一同前往县城。
回县城沿途，只打了一个火把，众人没走官道，反倒是穿梭在林中，小心翼翼摸黑前进。
矿奴们不明所以，但刘刚是这样命令的，众人只好这样做。
本以为这二十里路凶险重重，但直到上午五点，天蒙蒙亮，什么事都没有发生。
刘刚脸色惊疑：“奇了怪了，黑狼帮难道没有人手埋伏吗？这不应该啊！”
直到来到县城南大门，刘刚都有些恍惚。
难道是黑狼帮虚张声势？
亦或者，张龙赵虎不是被黑狼帮的人所杀。
想不明白，刘刚还是按照原计划行事。
“都给我站好，你们是干什么的，入城的话每人三文钱！”县兵昂首挺胸的吃拿卡要，哪怕是帮派的人，照样得给钱放人。
“官爷，我是毒蛇帮的头目刘刚，这是一钱银子，多余的就当我孝敬给你们的茶水钱。”刘刚满脸笑意的取出一钱银子递了上去。
“嗯，算你小子会做人，进去吧。”
三十人成功入城，立刻沿着大街朝毒蛇帮的总帮跑去。
赵寒还是第一次来县城，不由好奇东张西望。
其他人也大致如此，和乡巴佬进城一样四处看去。
凉州黑水县仅仅是偏远小县城一座，有着三万人口，其中两万都住在乡下。
街道还算宽敞，人流却不多。

加上正值乱世当下，物价飞涨。
本来能抵蓝星两千块的一两银子，现如今估计只有一千五，再过一阵子怕不是只有一千。
这样的环境，人就更少了。
content_en:
After placing the bodies, everyone returned to the mine. Wang Hu and Liu Gang immediately went to report to the hall leader Li Dalong.
Entering the tent, the two of them only saw a slightly white corpse on the ground, with blood flowing from the chrysanthemum. Obviously, this was another masterpiece of Li Dalong.
Li Er was like that before, and so was Zhang San.
The two knew Li Dalong's temperament, so they didn't care and hurriedly reported it.
"First, there were inside and outside cooperation to attack my mine, and now they assassinate my elite gang members. The Black Wolf Gang bullied me too much."
"Now that we, Du Long Tang, are in danger, Liu Gang, I order you to take some people to the county seat and ask for support from the general gang." Li Dalong stood up and said with an ugly face.
The Black Wolf Gang has gone too far.
There were a lot of minor frictions between the two gangs, but those who died were ordinary gang members, and it had not reached such a situation where elite gang members were specifically targeted.
Obviously, the Black Wolf Gang has big plans.
"Yes!" Liu Gang accepted the order with an ugly face, and exited the tent under Wang Hu's sneer eyes.
"Huh... It's not good now. The mine is twenty miles away from the county seat, and there are no telling how dangerous it is along the way."
Liu Gang knew very well that Li Dalong was treating him as a stepping stone.
He said he was going to the county town to ask for help, but in fact he was going to test the Black Wolf Gang. In other words, he was going to die, but he had no choice.
"No, I have to find a few more people."
Helpless, Liu Gang went to the mine slaves' dilapidated tent and woke up many of the mine slaves.
"Everyone, I'm going back to the county now. I need some courageous people. Do you have any of you who can follow me? As long as I get back safely and return to the mine, you will be members of my Viper Gang from now on."
Many mine slaves looked at each other, and many people immediately stood up.
Given the chance to move up, everyone would sign up.
Liu Gang's face lit up and he quickly picked up his manpower.
He directly found twenty taller mining slaves, and the other mining slaves looked disappointed.
"Zhao Han, Zhao Da... you guys come with me to the county town and go back to the main gang to ask for help."
Zhao Hanzheng returned to bed and just lay down to close his eyes when he was woken up by Liu Gang.
There was no choice but to follow.
In addition, Liu Gang also selected three elite gang members, a total of thirty people, to go to the county town together.
Along the way back to the county town, only one torch was lit. Instead of taking the official road, everyone walked through the forest and moved forward cautiously in the dark.
The mine slaves didn't know why, but Liu Gang gave the order and everyone had no choice but to do so.
I thought that the twenty-mile journey was full of dangers, but until five o'clock in the morning, when the sky was dark, nothing happened.
Liu Gang looked surprised: "It's strange, doesn't the Black Wolf Gang have manpower to ambush? This shouldn't be the case!"
Liu Gang was in a daze until he arrived at the south gate of the county.
Could it be that the Black Wolf Gang was bluffing?
Or maybe Zhang Long and Zhao Hu were not killed by people from the Black Wolf Gang.
Unable to figure it out, Liu Gang still acted according to the original plan.
"Stand still, what are you doing? If you enter the city, you will be given three cents per person!" The county soldiers held their heads high and asked for cards. Even if they were gang members, they still had to give money to let people go.
"My lord, I am Liu Gang, the leader of the Viper Gang. This is one coin of silver. Any extra can be treated as tea money that I will give you as a courtesy." Liu Gang took out the one coin of silver and handed it over with a smile on his face.
"Well, I guess you know how to be a good person, so go in."
Thirty people successfully entered the city and immediately ran along the street towards the headquarter of the Viper Gang.
It was Zhao Han's first time coming to the county town, and he couldn't help but look around curiously.
The others were much the same way, looking around like country bumpkins entering town.
Heishui County in Liangzhou is just a small remote county with a population of 30,000, of which 20,000 live in the countryside.
The streets are quite spacious, but there are not many people.
In addition, during these troubled times, prices are soaring.
One tael of silver that could originally be worth Blue Star's two thousand yuan is now estimated to be only one thousand and fifty yuan, and it may not be only one thousand yuan in a while.
In such an environment, there are even fewer people.
